system_description.narrative_title: Trump's political instability: Guilfoyle fallout and midterm risk
system_description.narrative_summary: A cycle of personnel scandal (Kimberly Guilfoyle's resignation/firing) and mounting legal and policy fights is eroding Donald Trump’s political standing and straining Republican midterm prospects. The system is open: scandals, court rulings, and polling shifts interact with campaign spending, voter mobilization (notably among Latino and working-class voters), and administrative actions (census, immigration enforcement), producing feedbacks that amplify or mitigate electoral risk. Guilfoyle’s ouster is a proximate catalyst that both signals internal governance strain and feeds media/legal scrutiny, with downstream effects on Senate races and party cohesion.
system_description.scope: Inside the system boundary: Trump's immediate political orbit (staff, envoys, pardons), Republican campaign strategy for 2026 midterms, voter blocs (Latino and working-class voters), legal and judicial contests involving the administration, administrative actions on immigration and census, and media/political-ad ecosystems.
system_description.super_system: The U.S. democratic-electoral and governance system (federal and state politics, judiciary, media ecosystem, and electoral institutions).
adjacent_subsystems: Federal judiciary and Supreme Court litigation
Electoral administration (census, voter eligibility, midterm mechanics)
Media, political advertising and campaign finance

variables.name: Political capital
variables.description: Measures the accumulated influence, credibility, and institutional goodwill available to advance agendas and absorb controversies.

variables.name: Scandal revelation rate
variables.description: Frequency at which new allegations, misconduct reports, or damaging disclosures emerge into public and legal channels.

variables.name: Legal challenge intensity
variables.description: Volume and intensity of ongoing investigations, lawsuits, prosecutions, and court actions targeting political actors or policies.

variables.name: Media scrutiny level
variables.description: Intensity and focus of investigative, mainstream, and social media attention on political actors, events, and networks.

variables.name: Campaign ad spending rate
variables.description: Rate of paid campaign expenditures on political messaging across broadcast, digital, and other paid channels.

variables.name: Paid ad volume rate
variables.description: Rate of paid political advertisement impressions and placements circulating in media markets and platforms.

variables.name: Voter mobilization rate
variables.description: Rate at which targeted voter blocs are being activated, registered, contacted, and turned out to vote.

variables.name: Latino voter alignment
variables.description: Aggregate preference alignment of Latino-identifying voters toward or against a party or political actor.

variables.name: Working-class voter alignment
variables.description: Aggregate preference alignment of working-class and economically concerned voters toward or against a party or political actor.

variables.name: Party cohesion level
variables.description: Degree of internal unity, coordinated messaging, and cooperative behaviour among aligned political actors and officeholders.

variables.name: Administrative enforcement rate
variables.description: Intensity and frequency of executive-branch policy implementation and enforcement actions across administrative domains.

variables.name: Judicial constraint strength
variables.description: Degree to which courts and judicial rulings limit, constrain, or reshape executive and administrative actions.

variables.name: Electoral institution integrity
variables.description: Strength, reliability, and perceived legitimacy of election administration, ballot processes, and vote tabulation systems.

variables.name: Public approval level
variables.description: Aggregated public approval or favorability rating of the political actor or administration across the electorate.

variables.name: Opposition candidate strength
variables.description: Aggregated competitiveness, organizational capacity, and public standing of opposing candidates across relevant races.

variables.name: Campaign fundraising flow
variables.description: Rate of monetary inflows to campaigns and associated political committees, including small-dollar and large-donor contributions.

catalysts.title: Guilfoyle follow-up media surge
catalysts.description: Ongoing media investigations and additional disclosures after Kimberly Guilfoyle's resignation likely produce new damaging revelations and sustained coverage.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple headlines: Guilfoyle resigns/fired, pieces on how she lost Trump's confidence and Davos boasting.

catalysts.title: Republican midterm ad blitz
catalysts.description: Large, funded Republican ad spending surge ramps paid ad volume and targeted outreach ahead of the 2026 midterms.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Republicans fund midterms ad blitz as Democrats gain in polls" and midterm ad market coverage.

catalysts.title: 2026 US midterm election day
catalysts.description: Election day will determine Senate/House control and materially shift Trump's political standing and party prospects.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Races that will decide control," "Trump battles to save the Senate," and midterm accept-results hedging.

catalysts.title: Supreme Court hears DOGE records dispute
catalysts.description: SCOTUS review of Trump's effort to shield DOGE records will affect legal exposure and disclosure precedents for his cases.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Supreme Court to hear Trump's fight to shield DOGE records from disclosure."

catalysts.title: DOJ lawsuit over California voter citizenship
catalysts.description: Federal suit challenging California's voter-roll practices will spur litigation and public debate over voter eligibility and administration.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "US Justice Dept sues California to block votes from alleged noncitizens" and related coverage.

catalysts.title: Legal fight over White House media access
catalysts.description: Appeals and court orders about White House bans and press access will continue, shaping media access and scrutiny levels.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Judge extends block on Trump White House ban of MS NOW, CNN and Politico" and related appeals.

catalysts.title: High‑stakes Texas Senate race outcome
catalysts.description: Result in Texas Senate race (Paxton/other) will affect Senate math, GOP messaging, and Trump's standing with the party base.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: "Ken Paxton Partied... Ahead of High‑Stakes Texas Senate Race" and Trump comments about blaming others if Paxton loses.

catalysts.title: Post‑election judicial confirmations blitz
catalysts.description: Planned Senate Republican push after the election to confirm Trump's judicial nominees could meaningfully alter judicial constraints.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: "Senate Republicans plan post-election blitz to confirm Trump's judicial nominees."
